High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Hypo (PC Errata 2)]] (the card with its Players Committee errata text and the errata mark) (A New Hope, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Hypo _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Wo-fMCYFRN5w36G0uS6g6vrPm5qs1tmU/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Hypo _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,342,576 bytes, SHA-256 <code>19353a4448257f9498e342f498fc19eb71a7c0b1cf9a0cd47cbd5a99c05d1447</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.0, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:ANH-D-hypo.gif]]; this file is shown there as the High-Res Scan.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
